title: MoM 2018-04-16
content:
Participants

Findings

  • Want LCM strategy for platforms
  • How do we detect anomalies?
  • How  do we aggregate and present costs?
  • How do we find out which services that need to be transitioned from?
  • What's the minimum handover knowledge requirements for the receiving organisation?
  • IPS & IDS strategy
  • What replaces OPAM's and IKAF?
  • Review process?
  • Minimum documentation requirements.
  • Documentation level standard on deployments
    • Draw IO vs visio?
    • Combination of marcus documents and aws documents?
    • Solution designs?
  • All accounts for clouds should be ordered centrally from ipex.
  • Cumulative updates and idempotend update operations
  • Automation vs documentation?

Actions

  • Document LCM strategy proposal
  • Investigate what Cloud services can provide
  • State each department that a project should sync with
    • IT security for information classification
    • Cloud services for billing & architecture
    • etc  etc
  • : Send LCM material for ICN deployed entities (LCM plan example for infrastructure platforms,  etc).
